claim: CFU Playground's iterative deploy-profile-optimize design loop for custom function units achieves 55x-75x speedups over an unaccelerated baseline soft CPU on embedded TinyML workloads.
stance_target: open-source full-stack co-design frameworks can deliver order-of-magnitude ML accelerator speedups on FPGAs, a viable basis for a publishable undergraduate accelerator project
scope_conditions: VexRiscv soft CPU + Custom Function Unit on FPGA, TensorFlow Lite Micro workloads
quoted_support: Using CFU Playground's design and evaluation loop, we show substantial speedups between 55x and 75x.

claim: CFU Playground is a fully open-source stack combining TFLM, GCC, LiteX/VexRiscv/Migen/Amaranth RTL generation, and yosys/nextpnr/F4PGA FPGA toolchains, avoiding vendor lock-in for custom ML accelerator research.
stance_target: toolchain choice for reproducible, low-cost FPGA TinyML student projects (relevant to Basys-3/open-source-tool angle)
quoted_support: The framework is unique in that it couples together various open-source software (TensorFlow Lite Micro/TFLM, GCC), open-source RTL generation IP and toolkits (LiteX, VexRiscv, Migen, Amaranth), and open-source FPGA tools for synthesis, place, and route (yosys, nextpnr, F4PGA/SymbiFlow, etc.).

claim: TinyML systems operate at MHz frequencies with only KBs of memory, few MB of storage, uW-mW power budgets, and <$10 unit cost, in stark contrast to Cloud (GHz, 10+GB, 100W-kW, $1000+) and Mobile ML tiers.
stance_target: quantifies the extreme resource constraints that justify custom lightweight FPGA accelerator research for undergraduate projects
scope_conditions: general TinyML vs Cloud/Mobile ML system comparison table
quoted_support: Tiny MHz KBs Few MB uW~mW < $10

claim: CFU Playground bundles Vizier, Google's open-source black-box optimizer, to automate design-space exploration of CPU-plus-custom-function-unit configurations.
stance_target: automated design-space exploration methodology reproducible in a student project's methodology section
quoted_support: We bundle CFU Playground with Vizier, an open-source black-box optimizer from Google to enable automated design space exploration of the CPU paired with a CFU.
